body:
Update @beicause 

We discussed this in the Working Group today and historically (9 years ago) we wrote the spec to say "the `VkSampler` must match" but `VK_KHR_maintenance4` allows you to destroy a `VkPipelineLayout` after creating a pipeline, so clearly it would be awful to still make an app keep the immutable sampler after

So to sum things up, this is not a Godot issue, but a Vulkan Validation Layer issue (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-ValidationLayers/issues/10560) is being used to track this and once we get that working, this `VUID-vkCmdDrawIndexed-None-08600` will either go away (most likely), or will describe exactly how the two immutable samplers are different
We just merged in https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-ValidationLayers/pull/10582 and that should fix this now
